thought_aesthetics.hierarchy: The main action, faces and physical drawing remain primary. A thought must clarify the text without becoming a competing hero object.
thought_aesthetics.source_style: Use the same simplified shape language, thin warm local-colour contours and quiet watercolor washes as the approved characters. Match detail density as well as medium and palette.
thought_aesthetics.detail_limit: Simple recognition motifs use broad shapes and sparse internal detail. A mental map has broad generalized landforms, no fine coastline, terrain, grid, labels, political borders or route. Preserve canonical story drawing marks exactly.
thought_aesthetics.size_method: Choose the smallest content size that remains clearly recognizable at intended reading size, then fit the minimal empty frame. Do not inherit a fixed 640px minimum from complex canonical drawings or fill every frame envelope.
thought_aesthetics.space_method: Plan a quiet region before generation. On an explicitly separate camera, recompose a complete interacting group uniformly when needed; record the changed camera and preserve background border. Same-camera groups retain measured physical scale.
thought_aesthetics.visual_gate: Inspect the entire page at 800px width alongside the approved scene style, then native details. Reject overlap, crowding at the border, ambiguous ownership, excessive contrast/detail, giant prop silhouettes or tiny unreadable content. Numeric fit alone is insufficient.

composition_performance_contract.scale_method: Native anatomical and rigid-prop endpoints -> one uniform scale -> second independent landmark check; never fit pose height as anatomy.
composition_performance_contract.relative_scale_authority: Named geometry artwork and persistent cross-chapter ratios; reconcile conflicting turnaround proportions before generating.
composition_performance_contract.registration: Keep actor/prop world anchors and at least three room/floor landmarks fixed at same camera/depth unless the passage moves them.
composition_performance_contract.camera_rule: Plan a motivated establishing/interaction/detail/emotional shot; genuine angle needs matching perspective sources. Reframe ALL physical layers and shadows together, preserve screen direction and painted border.
composition_performance_contract.expression_rule: Each visible participant has named readable emotion, gaze recipient, brow/eye/mouth/head/gesture evidence at reading size.
composition_performance_contract.grounding_rule: Verified actual bearing surfaces, one owner, attached low-alpha contact core and soft wash; no white gap; no shadows under imagined/airborne objects.
composition_performance_contract.uniqueness_rule: Every page communicates its own text through action/response/meaningful view; no exact or cosmetic-only duplicate.
